properties.name: Pace On Demand
properties.units: Batavia city; Hoffman Estates village; Lansing village; Naperville city; Aurora city; Arlington Heights village; Rolling Meadows city; Round Lake village; St. Charles city; Geneva city; Vernon Hills village; Mundelein village; Joliet city; Wheaton city; Winfield village
properties.note: Pace On Demand is 11 separate named zones (Batavia; Hoffman Estates; Lansing Area; Naperville-Aurora; Northwest Cook [Arlington Heights-Rolling Meadows]; Round Lake Area; Southeast Aurora; St. Charles-Geneva; Vernon Hills-Mundelein; West Joliet; Wheaton-Winfield), each covering only part of the named municipalities, not full city limits -- e.g. the Naperville-Aurora zone is bounded by I-88, Ferry Rd, Warrenville Rd, Naper Blvd, Gartner Rd, West St, Ogden Ave and Eola Rd (per RTA Chicago blog). No zone-by-zone size or street-boundary data is published for the other 10 zones, so all listed municipalities are used as approximate containing units. Source: https://www.pacebus.com/on-demand ; https://www.rtachicago.org/blog/2022/06/29/pace-introduces-vango-and-expands-naperville-aurora-on-demand-mobility-services
